fps_support.reason: 30.0 fps is inside the 23 to 31 fps range every published accuracy number was measured on.

models.court: ResNet-50 14-keypoint regression (models/keypoints_model_geoaug.pth), per frame, 5-frame moving-average smoothing
models.court_mapping: cv2.findHomography RANSAC 10px, 14 keypoints -> MiniCourt reference court
models.events: utils.hit_bounce_classifier.derive_shot_frames (3 candidate generators + trajectory classifier + rally decoding)

coordinate_system.origin: far-left corner of the doubles court (as seen from the camera)
coordinate_system.x: across the court, 0 = far-left doubles sideline, 10.97 = right doubles sideline
coordinate_system.y: along the court, 0 = far baseline, 23.76 = near baseline

calibration.reason: 12 of 12 sampled frames sit on painted court lines (median support 0.733)

selection.warning: Player tracking is incomplete: player 2 is missing for 17 consecutive frames. Shots played during those stretches cannot be attributed, so the per-player counts are an under-count.

players.selection_reason: Player tracking is incomplete: player 2 is missing for 17 consecutive frames. Shots played during those stretches cannot be attributed, so the per-player counts are an under-count.

court_status_meaning.measured: feet (bbox bottom-centre) mapped through that frame's homography; players stand on the floor so this is valid
court_status_meaning.outside_plausible_area: mapped more than 6 m beyond a sideline or 9 m beyond a baseline - treated as a mapping failure, withheld
court_status_meaning.no_homography: the frame's keypoints could not be fitted, withheld
court_status_meaning.court_calibration_failed: the clip failed the court-validity gate, all court positions withheld

players.xy_m_smoothed: main.py's Kalman smoother (utils.kalman_smoother) for display; xy_m is the unsmoothed measurement

image_status_meaning.detected: TrackNet output on this frame (centre of its 24x24 box)
image_status_meaning.interpolated: gap of <= 10 frames between detections, linearly interpolated + 3-frame median (main.py's interpolate_ball_positions)
image_status_meaning.unavailable: no detection and gap too long (or at the clip edge) to interpolate honestly

court_status_meaning.bounce: ball projected at its lowest image point within +/-4 frames of a detected bounce - ball on the floor, homography valid
court_status_meaning.contact_approx: ball is in the air at a racket contact; the hitter's feet are used as its ground point (approximate, same rule as main.py 3-D)
court_status_meaning.interpolated: straight-line, constant-speed ground track between two anchors at most 2.0 s apart - an estimate, not a measurement
court_status_meaning.unavailable: no reliable ground position; an airborne ball is never projected through the floor homography

known_limits: README: TrackNet median localisation error 5.4 px, 90th percentile 18 px (TrackNet dataset)
README: contact/bounce recall ~72% on real detections - missed events break the court interpolation into gaps or straight lines through a missed bounce
Ball height is not measured; no 3-D position is exported here

ball_clean.method: tracklet association with a speed bound; unconfirmed blips rejected; interpolation only inside a tracklet across <= 2 missing frames and never across an event

demo.timing: clip frame i has presentation time i/fps, identical to the source video
